scene: The opened iron lockbox clicks, sliding apart the shop's back walls.
picture: A wide flat side view of the repair shop. On the far left, a red mail train idles at a low indoor platform. Left of centre, the player stands by the workbench beside his motorbike. To the right, a tow truck waits in an open garage bay. Far right sits a glass-domed funicular.
shown: a miniature steam mail train idling on tracks on the far left
a yellow tow truck driver waving through open garage bay on the right
a brass funicular car waiting beside a lit ticket turnstile on the far right
